[NCBK.6.10] **Arguments are typed.** Each argument is `{ name, kind, value }`:
`name` is the kwarg's name, `kind` a call-argument kind (`ds_arg_kind_t`,
[NFCT.2.7]), and `value` the member of `ds_arg_value_t` that kind names. A
`Json` argument is a parsed tree, as a `Json` slot value is ([NFCT.2.4]).

A kwarg whose value is a fact ([LADP.8.6.1]) is an argument of kind
`DS_ARG_ENCODED_FACT`: the bound fact's `FactExternal` encoding ([RFCS.23.1]) as
a byte string and its length, and beside them the fact's schema name and
`asserted_at` ([RFCS.23.5]), so the integrator can route the fact without
reading inside it. Nothing else is lifted out of the encoding. The integrator
may forward the bytes without decoding them; another tier's engine asserts them
through `ds_engine_assert_external` ([NCBK.10.4]).

A kwarg with no value prevents the call ([LNUL.11.1]), so no call callback
receives `DS_ARG_NULL`. `ds_arg_kind_t` holds the member because it holds every
common kind ([NFCT.2.7]).
